subject.title: fix(agents): route llama.cpp GBNF cleaning through provider tool-schema hooks

question: Should `modelCompat.toolSchemaProfile: "llamacpp"` and the exported `llamacpp-gbnf` provider-tools family become supported public configuration and plugin-SDK contracts?
rationale: The patch fixes a real compatibility failure, but it adds both a named user configuration mode and reusable public SDK helpers whose long-term compatibility promise needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt and document the contract
options.body: Keep the explicit profile and provider-owned family hooks, add user/plugin documentation with activation and compatibility behavior, and treat the exported helpers as supported SDK surface.

options.title: Keep the fix internal
options.body: Rescope the implementation so it does not expose a new public compatibility profile or general plugin-SDK family until a separate API proposal is accepted.

recommendation.title: Adopt and document the contract
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit profile and provider-owned family hooks, add user/plugin documentation with activation and compatibility behavior, and treat the exported helpers as supported SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Their related PR demonstrates direct familiarity with the same llama.cpp tool-schema compatibility boundary, though current-main ownership evidence remains limited.
